mentions.name: Apikulture
mentions.description: A small, fast API client serving as a local alternative to Postman and Insomnia that does not upload user data to the cloud. Written in C++ with the Slint UI framework (used as a testbed for Slint); CI integration for producing binaries is still pending, so it currently must be compiled from source.
mentions.problem: Existing API clients like Postman and Insomnia upload user data to the cloud.
mentions.source_excerpt: Apikulture. A small, fast alternative to Postman/Insomnia that doesn't upload your data to the cloud.
